{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Niicee''''' was a group of 6 [[Class-B cargo container|Class-B]] [[Cargo container/Legends|containers]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. One of the containers, ''Niicee 5'', contained a [[Missile Boat]] prototype called ''[[Sealion]]'' and was planned to be transported to an undisclosed location to dissect it and learn how to duplicate it. The Rebels didn't have the chance to as [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces led by [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]] would launch an [[Recovery of the Sealion|recovery]] operation on the container that housed the ''Sealion'', the rest that contained [[Warhead/Legends|warheads]] were destroyed.
